reference type

  • CURIE: gmeow:referenceType
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceType
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The kind of cadastral reference (parcel ID, folio number, title number, lot number, survey plan reference, etc.). Non-functional: a single reference may be classified by multiple sources as different types.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CadastralReference -> gmeow:CadastralReferenceType

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:referenceType from gmeow:CadastralReference to gmeow:CadastralReferenceType when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CadastralReference, gmeow:CadastralReferenceType

Generated from the GMEOW ontology. Canonical source is RDF/OWL; this site is a deterministic projection.
